newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong to host IMF forum in March.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong to host IMF forum in March.

text.p: Hong Kong, vying to host the secretariat of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) in Asia, would be the venue of a major IMF financial forum in March, a Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) spokesman said on Friday.

The HKMA, the territory's defacto central bank, and the IMF are jointly organising a conference, "Financial integration in Asia and the role of Hong Kong", in Hong Kong on March 7 but details are still being finalised, the spokesman said.
The British-run territory, which reverts to Chinese sovereignty at midnight June 30, is also hosting the annual World Bank/IMF meeting in September.
Hong Kong is also hoping to be the home of the IMF's planned regional office in Asia.
"The IMF is looking for a secretariat in Asia and they have looked at Hong Kong," said the HKMA spokesman.
The spokesman, who declined to give further details, would only say the IMF was also considering other options in Asia.
